questions.text: Critically examine the incidents of human rights violations taking place around you.
questions.text_as_printed: Critically examine the incidents of human rights violations taking place around you. (Difficult)

answer.value:
Human Rights Violations Around Us:
Child labour, violence against women, denial of education to children, and discrimination based on caste and religion are common human rights violations. These affect the freedom and dignity of individuals. Such violations can be prevented through strict enforcement of laws and by creating awareness about human rights.

Develop scientific temper, humanism, and the spirit of inquiry and reform.
Safeguard public property and avoid violence.
Strive for excellence in all spheres of individual and collective activity.
Provide educational opportunities to children aged 6 to 14 years.

questions.text: Do you think caste inequality still exists in India? Express your views in your own words.
questions.text_as_printed: Do you think caste inequality still exists in India? Express your views in your own words. (Difficult)

answer.value:
Caste Equality in India:
The Constitution of India provides equal rights and opportunities to all citizens. Everyone is equal before the law. However, caste-based discrimination, untouchability, and social inequality still exist in some areas. The government promotes equality through reservation, education, and welfare schemes. With increasing education and social awareness, caste discrimination is gradually decreasing. Although significant progress has been made, more efforts are needed to achieve complete caste equality.
